title: Skills
intro: Skills are instruction packages: a folder with a SKILL.md (when and how to do something) plus optional reference files and scripts. Install them from GitHub, a .zip, a folder or a single .md, assign them to agents or teams, and agents read them when the work fits.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.hint: Add one from GitHub (e.g. a frontend design or finance skill), from your computer, or write your own.

selectHint: Pick a skill on the left.

detail.enabledHint: When off, no agent sees this skill.
detail.updateConfirm: Re-download from the source and replace the files? Edits made in Agentbits are lost; assignments are kept.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{{name}}"? Agents lose access to it. This cannot be undone (backups still contain it).
detail.binaryFile: Not a text file — stored, not shown.

assign.title: Who can use it
assign.hint: Assign to agents, or to a team / department / company: all its members (and those of its sub-units) get it. The organization = every agent.
assign.none: No one yet — agents only see skills assigned to them.

modal.title: Add skill
modal.githubHint: A repository, a folder in it (several skills are found automatically), a SKILL.md or any .md file. Public repositories only.
modal.computerHint: A skill folder (with SKILL.md), a .zip of one or more skills, or a single .md file. You can also drop it here.
modal.writeHint: Front matter with name and description is required; the description tells agents when to use the skill.
modal.writeTemplate:
---
name: my-skill
description: "When to use this skill, in one or two sentences."
---
